newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media to Aug 10.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media to Aug 10.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to Aug 10, 1997
The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
CONTEST ENTRY DEADLINES:

ADVERTISING MARKETING EFFECTIVENESS - Global competition sponsored by The New York Festivals, designed to recognise effectiveness and creativity of advertising and marketing campaigns from a global vantage point. Entry fee $375. Deadline for entries: September 30, 1997. Contact: 1 914 238 4481. Web site: http://www.nyfests.com
MONDAY, JULY 14

LONDON - Sports Sponsorship conference. Includes how to identify potential sponsors, prepare sponsorship bids, understand what sponsors want from the relationship, what to do when things go wrong and you find yourself going into receivership. Forum Hotel, London. Contact: (44) 171 434 3711. (two-day conference July 14-15)
TUESDAY, JULY 15

LONDON - Sports Sponsorship conference. Includes how to identify potential sponsors, prepare sponsorship bids, understand what sponsors want from the relationship, what to do when things go wrong and you find yourself going into receivership. Forum Hotel, London. (two-day conference July 14-15)
THURSDAY, JULY 17

CAMBRIDGE - Advertising Association 1997 Peterhouse Seminar. "How effective is advertising self-regulation and could it be improved?" Chaired by Lord Borrie, former director general of fair trading. Contact: 0171 828 2771. (two-day seminar, July 17-18)
FRIDAY, JULY 18

CAMBRIDGE - Advertising Association 1997 Peterhouse Seminar. "How effective is advertising self-regulation and could it be improved?" Chaired by Lord Borrie, former director general of fair trading. Contact: 0171 828 2771. (two-day seminar, July 17-18)
THURSDAY, JULY 24

LONDON - The Hard Commercial Edge of PR. Conference will examine growing importance of communications as a central, strategic business discipline and considers challenge for PR industry as communications moves upstream. Church House Conference Centre, Dean's yard, Westminster, London SW1. Contact: (44) 171 222 2348. (two-day conference July 24-25)
FRIDAY, JULY 25

LONDON - The Hard Commercial Edge of PR. Conference will examine growing importance of communications as a central, strategic business discipline and considers challenge for PR industry as communications moves upstream. Church House Conference Centre, Dean's yard, Westminster, London SW1. Contact: (44) 171 222 2348. (two-day conference July 24-25)
TUESDAY, JULY 29

LONDON - Creative Radio Workshop for Advertisers. How to encourage and assess good radio scripts; how to create a space for your brand on the airwaves; getting the best out of the "invisible" medium. Jointly conducted by the Incorporated Society of British Advertisers and the Radio Advertising Bureau. The London Business School, Sussex Place, Regent's Park, London NW1. Contact: (44) 171 306 2573
